Position Summary...
   

  

 What you'll do...Distinguished Engineer – AI \& Data Walmart Global Tech \| AI \& Data Organization Position Summary As a Distinguished Engineer in the AI \& Data organization, you will serve as a senior individual contributor and technical leader responsible for shaping the long\-term technical vision, architecture, and engineering excellence of our enterprise\-scale AI/ML systems and platforms. You will work across teams to influence complex technical decisions, embed responsible AI foundations, and deliver scalable, resilient solutions that empower builders across Walmart. This role goes beyond hands\-on engineering — it is about driving technical strategy, architecting for scale, and mentoring technical leaders to elevate engineering standards across the organization. What You’ll Do Technical Vision \& Architecture
   

  

* Define and drive the technical vision for AI/ML platforms and ecosystems that operate at enterprise scale.
* Lead architecture reviews and design principles across GenAI integrations, model serving, and intelligent pipelines.
* Establish architectural standards for reliability, security, scalability, and performance aligned with enterprise requirements.
* Translate complex business needs into high\-impact, long\-term technical roadmaps.


 AI/ML Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide hands\-on technical guidance and thought leadership to multi\-team engineering and data science groups.
* Influence AI/ML lifecycle practices, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and observability.
* Shape patterns for safe and governed AI adoption across internal platforms.
* Lead cutting\-edge prototyping and production strategies for mission\-critical AI systems.


 Cross–Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with product, business, UX, data science, infrastructure, and governance teams to accelerate value delivery.
* Advocate for engineering best practices and foster alignment across diverse technology domains.
* Influence senior stakeholders, including executives, on technical trade\-offs and strategic decisions.


 Engineering Excellence \& Mentorship
   

  

* Elevate engineering excellence by mentoring senior ICs, principal engineers, and emerging technical talent.
* Champion best practices in code quality, system reliability, CI/CD pipelines, and operational maturity.
* Sponsor and drive technical communities of practice to raise standards across AI \& Data.


 What You’ll Bring Required Qualifications
   

  

* 12\+ years of experience building and operating large\-scale, distributed software systems.
* Proven track record as a senior individual contributor driving system architecture or technical strategy.
* Deep experience with AI/ML production systems, model serving, orchestration, and performance optimization.
* Experience with observability practices, including structured logging, metrics, traces, and debugging distributed flows across client and gateway environments.
* Strong expertise in scalable, cloud\-native design and platform engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineers and leaders without direct managerial authority.
* Excellent communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience leading AI/ML systems or platforms in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience with LLM tool\-calling or agentic systems (e.g., structured tool invocation, schema validation, prompt/tool design, guardrails).
* Familiarity with schema/contract frameworks (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Pydantic, protobuf) and backward\-compatible tool evolution.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices and governance frameworks.
* Experience with GenAI, prompt engineering patterns, or large\-scale inference infrastructure.
* Proven mentorship and leadership across multiple engineering teams.


 What You’ll Do Day\-to\-Day
   

  

* Drive architectural decisions with measurable technology impact.
* Evaluate and recommend cutting\-edge technologies to solve complex AI challenges.
* Advocate for platform performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Participate in code reviews, design sessions, and system retrospectives.
* Mentor and elevate senior engineers and technical teams across AI \& Data.


 Why This Role Matters In AI \& Data, we empower teams across Walmart to rapidly innovate with AI and data at scale. The Distinguished Engineer will be a technical compass for this effort — shaping how we build, scale, and govern AI systems that serve millions of associates and customers worldwide. Your impact will extend beyond a single product or platform; it will influence Walmart’s engineering culture and technological future. At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance\-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Other benefits include short\-term and long\-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.
